{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
sales_filtered = sales[~qa_mask]

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales_filtered[
    (sales_filtered['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (sales_filtered['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Confirm the number of loyal, completed orders
n_loyal_completed = len(loyal_completed)

# Print results
print("Number of loyal, completed orders (excluding QA):", n_loyal_completed)
print("Mean revenue for loyal, completed orders (excluding QA):", mean_revenue)"}
